newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers down $1.00/T on thin demand.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers down $1.00/T on thin demand.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes were slightly lower from Monday's levels on thin demand, traders said.

They said shipowners were assessing market conditions before buying their requirements. Some sellers were also concerned about the near term direction of the fuel oil cargo market. "Its recent volatility has placed some mixed sentiment," said one trader. Bunker 380-cst was quoted at $99 by most majors with independents seen at $96. Bunker 180-cst were quoted at $106-$107 per tonne by most traders.
